Exact finite-deck draw probability without replacement. This is not a
battlefield, tutor, mulligan or Arena smoothing model.

get.summary: List persisted simulation jobs in stable creation order using opaque cursors.

post.summary:
Queue a seeded local simulation. Inputs and model versions are frozen before
execution; retries with the same key return the original job.

get.summary: Read durable progress and results. A missing report means no completed trials.

post.summary:
Request cancellation. Bounded batches preserve completed-trial denominators;
cancelling an already terminal job is an idempotent read of its final state.

get.summary: Read the frozen card metadata and parameters used by a job, not today's catalog.
Observe game-level performance with explicit denominators. Unknowns are excluded from decisive win rate; recorded land counters cover only sampled local turns.

card.description: The original printing metadata; null explicitly means unresolved.

unknown_results.description: Games without one unambiguous observed local outcome, including unfinished games.

Estimate.description: Wilson score interval, with explicit numerator and denominator.

land_drops_observed.description: Recorded land counters on observed local turns; not an inferred full-game total.

local_time.description: Zone-less Arena log clock; not silently interpreted as UTC.

match_instant_utc.description: Explicit match clock evidence; not a reconstructed game-start timestamp.

categories.description:
Mutually exclusive categories covering the whole deck, including other cards.
Split overlapping groups into explicit intersections before using this model.

text.description: Plain text tokens across names, rules text and types. Not raw FTS syntax.

seed.description: Full-width hexadecimal seed. Omit to generate and persist a random seed.

conditional_lands.description: Potential land color depends on board state or spending restriction.

nonland_sources.description: Includes summoning-sick or restricted creature/artifact mana abilities.

unrestricted_lands.description: Color always available once untapped, with no spending restriction.

decisive_win_rate.description: Wins / (wins + losses), excluding draws and unknown results.
